subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
PRIORITY CORRECTION FIRST (v1 got this wrong and it matters). v1 presented finding 1 — that two split symbols reached through ONE relocation are one declared C object — as new. It is NOT: claim.law.single-base-relocation-refutes-symbol-separation.20260831.v1 (subject tu:game/shop/shop, recorded 2026-08-31T06:33, about seventeen hours EARLIER) already states the core claim and its discriminator. This record CONFIRMS that law from an independent TU and adds only two things to it: a second emitted SHAPE, and the constructive cure. Read that law first; this one extends it.

EXTENSION A - A SECOND SHAPE OF THE SAME EVIDENCE. The prior law's discriminator is one ADDR16_HA/LO pair followed by plain `addi rX,rX,<const>` per region. The same proof also appears with NO addi at all, the region offset folded directly into the LOAD/STORE DISPLACEMENT: target holds `addi rHOME,rT,A@lo` once and then emits `stw r3,1412(r4)` where r4 = rHOME + a variable index. A compiler cannot fold a cross-object distance into a displacement any more than into an addi, so this shape carries the identical proof. In sounds_evt, sSpeechNameBuf (.bss 0x8028B5D0, size 0x40) and sActiveTrackId (.bss 0x8028BA80, size 0x238) are exactly 0x4B0 apart and AudioSetupBossStreams reaches ids at sSpeechNameBuf+0x4B0..0x6C4.

EXTENSION B - THE CONSTRUCTIVE CURE, WHICH THE PRIOR LAW DID NOT HAVE. That law is stated defensively ('keep base+offset, do not respell against the neighbour symbol') because its own case could not be named. When the layout IS derivable, declare ONE record spanning both symbols and keep the FIRST symbol as the relocated base (per claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity): here `typedef struct { char name[0x40]; u8 pad_40[0x470]; s32 activeTrack[45]; s32 boss[12][8]; } SpeechBlock;` over `(SpeechBlock*)sSpeechNameBuf`. The layout fell out of the offsets with no guesswork: 0x4B0 + 45*4 = 0x564 is exactly where the row table starts and the 0x20 row stride makes it [12][8]. Never re-base to the second symbol — that emits a different relocation, which is precisely what the prior law measured as a regression.

FINDING 2 (THE LOAD-BEARING ONE) - THE ALIAS THAT DEFEATS REMATERIALISATION DOES NOT HAVE TO BE SOURCE-DECLARED, AND REMOVING THE SOURCE ALIAS IS NOT SUFFICIENT. This is a BOUNDARY on claim.law.cached-base-alias-defeats-rematerialized-index-base.20260831.v1, whose prescription is to remove cached aliases so MWCC rematerialises `add rX,rBase,rIdx` per access. Two measurements bracket it. (a) POSITIVE, sounds_evt: the function held NO source alias of the parent law's kind and still hoisted, because the ACCESS SPELLING alone was enough — 15 accesses written `*(s32*)(base + CONST + i * 4)` let MWCC reassociate to (base + i*4) + CONST, find `base + i*4` common across all 15, and park that SYNTHESISED value in a callee-saved GPR for the whole function. Respelling every access as an array reference into a declared record (`speech->boss[n][idx]`) restored the target shape exactly: MWCC then CSEd ONLY the index shift (`slwi r29,r25,2`, once) and rematerialised `add rX,r30,r29` before each access. (b) NEGATIVE, gauntworld::fn_80062A00: this function DOES hold the parent law's canonical alias, `row = rt + off;` inside the loop, with 8 uses at offsets 0/600/1200/1800/2400/29216. Deleting the local and respelling all 8 sites as `*(f32*)(rt + off + K)` — the parent law's literal all-or-nothing prescription — measured real 430 -> 432 with the opcode multiset UNCHANGED at 20 tokens and the SAME twelve clusters, including all six `add`+`lfsx`/`stfsx` rows. MWCC simply re-synthesised `rt + off` from the cast arithmetic. CONCLUSION: alias removal is necessary but not sufficient; what discriminates is whether the access is a cast-arithmetic expression (PRE sees a reassociable address tree and hoists) or an array/member reference into a DECLARED record (PRE does not). Read the parent law's precondition as: hold no cached alias AND spell each access as an array/member reference into a declared record — raw offset arithmetic behind a cast is itself a cached alias, and deleting the named one only removes the label.

FINDING 3 - PROBING ONE SITE OF AN N-SITE CSE POPULATION MEASURES NOTHING. The prior pass on AudioSetupBossStreams (attempt.sounds-evt-bossstreams-aligned-read-followup.20260831.v2) spent both probes respelling a SINGLE access, correctly measured both byte-identical, and generalised that null into a closed axis citing claim.law.address-pre-hoist-survives-every-address-spelling. A single occurrence has no common subexpression to defeat, so the null was guaranteed by the experimental design rather than by the compiler. RULE: before spending a probe on an address-form residual, COUNT the sites sharing the subexpression — `fndiff --ops` does it for free, `+18 add` naming both mechanism and population in one line — then convert the whole population or not at all. The address-pre-hoist law's scope is sound where measured (a hoist serving one site or a fixed pair) and does not extend to a multi-site population where the spelling determines whether the population exists at all.

FINDING 4 - IMAGE-WIDE CENSUS: THE POPULATION IS 11 AND IT IS STRICTLY ONE-DIRECTIONAL. `python tools/gdl/add_remat_census.py` (writes build/AR_paired.json) joins build/GUNE5D/asm with build/GUNE5D/src the way addr16_census.py does and reports, per paired function, d_add = target `add` count minus ours and d_insn = target insn count minus ours. Over 2983 paired functions, 849 non-identical: the fingerprint (d_add >= 3 AND ours SHORT) holds for 11 functions, and the INVERSE population — ours emitting 3 or more MORE adds than target — is ZERO. As with the addrlo census's S=0, a strictly one-directional divergence is the signature of a real mechanism rather than noise. Roster, d_add/d_insn: shop::do_shopping_8009AA48 10/3, shop::do_shop 8/6, shop::write_shop_menu 5/8, gauntworld::fn_80062A00 4/6, screensaver::draw_inventory_panel 4/5, player::do_players 3/14, options::DoOptions 3/5, shop::show_gold 3/3, gamemain::fn_80051C78 3/2, gamemain::fn_80057024 3/2, shop::fn_8009A0AC 3/1. CRITICAL SCREENING NOTE: the five shop entries are all functions over the lbl_802897D0 draw-layout buffer and are ALREADY BLOCKED by a measured do-not-retry — attempt.shop-drawlayout-buffer-cleanup.20260831.v1 established that the buffer's field names are unavailable (the Xbox SHOP.OBJ roster has no counterpart for the big tables) so a declared record there would be invention. Extension B is therefore unavailable for 5 of the 11; the live candidates are the other 6, of which fn_80062A00's negative above is already recorded. Do not re-run the shop symbol-separation axis.
